pin.title: Set PIN
pin.notice: To postpone appointments and verify your identity in office, you have to set a personal, numerical 6-digit PIN. The PIN can no longer be changed or checked after confirming.

share_auth.title: PIN
share_auth.text: It is important that you keep this PIN in a safe place because it is used to check your identity. You can use this PIN to move or change your appointments at a later date. Without the PIN, we cannot process your applications in the office correctly because it is required for authentication. It is also necessary to download the document that contains your PIN.
share_auth.notice: The PIN is needed for the appointment. Download the identification document and save the PIN.
share_auth.confirm_pin_saved: Yes, I noted my PIN and downloaded the document for anonymous identification.
